classification.strict_rule_definition: diagnostic signature max error <= .10, matching largest causal influence, and winner mean hard-flip rate >= .50

inversion.compatibility: absolute closure error <= evaluation.equivalence_margin and every weight lies in [-margin, 1+margin]

purity_stratification.interpretation: Aggregate static-mixture compatibility is stratified by the existing strict pure-goal classification; compatibility among non-pure policies is the relevant diagnostic for a genuinely mixed behavioral account.
